en:
Industry-specific labels

“Total ○○” badge names follow the label of the industry with the most approved services (if most industries have no label, “Total closed”) — so a solar-only label like “Total installs” never shows up on other industries.
proposed:
Industry-specific labels

The ○○ in “N+ ○○ completed” badge names follows the label of the industry with the most approved services (if most industries have no label, “deals”) — so a solar-only label like “projects” never shows up on other industries.
reason_ko: 배지 이름 실제 영어(‘{n}+ {label} completed’, projects·deals)와 설명 속 Total closed·Total installs 가 맞지 않음
